description: A React component for displaying a modal with file previews, supporting images, videos, PDFs, code, and other file types, with navigation and zoom controls.

classes.name: FilePreviewModal
classes.description: A React component for previewing files in a modal with navigation, zoom, and various file type supports.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Navigate to the next file in the preview list.

methods.name: handlePrev
methods.description: Navigate to the previous file in the preview list.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handle keyboard events for navigation.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Set up event listeners and initialize image display.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Remove event listeners.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Update state based on new props, especially for PDF and loading states.

methods.name: showImage
methods.description: Display image at specified index and load it if not loaded.

methods.name: isImageUrl
methods.description: Check if a URL points to an image or SVG.

methods.name: getFileTypeFromFileInfo
methods.description: Determine file type from FileInfo or LinkInfo.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Load image preview or handle non-image files.

methods.name: handleImageLoaded
methods.description: Mark image as loaded.

methods.name: handleImageProgress
methods.description: Update image loading progress.

methods.name: onMouseEnterImage
methods.description: Show close button on mouse hover.

methods.name: onMouseLeaveImage
methods.description: Hide close button when mouse leaves.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Set zoom scale for current image.

methods.name: handleZoomIn
methods.description: Zoom into the image.

methods.name: handleZoomOut
methods.description: Zoom out of the image.

methods.name: handleZoomReset
methods.description: Reset zoom to default.

methods.name: handleModalClose
methods.description: Close the modal.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Update content state.

methods.name: handleBgClose
methods.description: Close modal on background click.
